en.text: Don't put the saddle on the wrong horse.
You're barking up the wrong tree.

indices: お門違い です よ[01]

original: オレを非難するのはお門違いだ。

en.text: You're at the wrong gate if you're here to criticize me.
It is the wrong place to criticize me.
Keep moving if you're here to criticize me.
You came to the wrong house to start criticizing me.
You've come to the wrong house if you're here to start criticizing me.
You're in the wrong place if you're here to criticize me.

indices: 俺(おれ){オレ} を 非難 為る(する){する} の は お門違い~ だ
